title: eval publish-report job payload

runId.description: The finished reprocess run (Runs.Id); the report is shown next to it.

pipelineVersionId.description: The version the run published or rolled back to (processing design §14: EvaluationSubject.PipelineVersionId).

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of an eval job of kind publish-report (processing design §14.1): the collection's full set on the full collection after the reprocess run of a publish or rollback, compared with the last run before the publish. Dedup eval-report:{runId}.
